watches.name: Coiba Automatic White with Forest Green Wristband
watches.description: COIBA Built to Keep Moving The BOCA Coiba marks a new chapter in our watch collection — a mechanical timepiece with a strong vintage character, designed around the beauty of an automatic movement. Its design takes inspiration from classic exploration and instrument watches, combining a distinctive stainless steel case with bold, highly legible dials and carefully considered details. The oversized crown and rotating bezel give Coiba a purposeful character, while the sapphire-coated crystal adds enhanced resistance to everyday wear while preserving the vintage character of the watch. Available in three distinctive dial colors — Ivory, Black, and White — each version gives Coiba its own personality. The Ivory and Black dials feature vintage-style Arabic numerals with warm luminous tones and subtle red accents, creating a distinctly retro character. The White dial takes a cleaner approach, with luminous circular hour markers and striking blue hands that give the watch a fresher, more contemporary expression. Despite their differences, all three share the same balanced minute track and strong visual identity. At its heart is the Japanese Miyota 8210 automatic movement , a mechanical movement powered by the motion of the wrist. With 21 jewels and an approximate 42-hour power reserve , Coiba requires no battery — a reminder of the mechanical tradition that has defined watchmaking for generations. Like every BOCA watch, Coiba is paired with one of our signature handcrafted leather straps, made in Mexico by our artisans . Each strap is carefully woven by hand, bringing texture, warmth, and individuality to the watch. Natural variations in the leather and handwork ensure that no two straps are exactly alike. The contrast between the mechanical movement, tool-watch-inspired case and handcrafted leather creates a watch that feels rugged yet refined — a meeting point between precision and imperfection, function and character. Designed in the spirit of BOCA's philosophy — Italian Design × Mexican Craft — Coiba is made for those who appreciate the ritual of wearing a mechanical watch and the character it develops over time. Specifications Movement: Japanese Miyota 8210 Automatic Functions: Hours, Minutes, Seconds, Date Jewels: 21 Power Reserve: Approximately 42 Hours Case Diameter: 39 mm / 1.53 in Case Thickness: 12 mm / 0.47 in Crystal: Sapphire-Coated Crystal Watch Face Color: White Strap: Handmade in Mexico using premium leather *Leather Strap Care and Maintenance Warranty: 2 Years COIBA. Mechanical by nature. Individual by design. * The color and texture of the leather used for our watch straps may vary slightly depending on the specific leather batch available at the time of production. Each strap is handmade, and natural variations are part of its unique character.

watches.description: Meet ROY , a contemporary take on a timeless silhouette, designed with clean lines, confident proportions, and the distinctive handcrafted details that define BOCA. Handmade in Italy from premium Mazzucchelli plant-based cellulose acetate , the ROY frame combines Italian craftsmanship with hand-braided leather details, carefully made in Mexico using fine sheepskin. The result is a refined yet relaxed design with a subtle artisanal character. ROY is available in three distinctive combinations: Tortoise with green lenses, Black with grey lenses, and Champagne with green lenses . Each color gives the frame its own personality, from classic and understated to light and sophisticated. The lenses provide 100% UVA and UVB protection and reduce light transmission by approximately 75% , offering excellent visual comfort while preserving natural color and clarity. Designed as a versatile unisex style , ROY has an easy, confident fit that works across different face shapes. A modern essential made for everyday wear, where Italian design meets Mexican craftsmanship. Materials and measurements: Frame: HANDMADE IN ITALY — Mazzucchelli plant-based cellulose acetate. watches.name: Heritage Sage with Tobacco Wristband
watches.description: HERITAGE Beyond Time Some designs belong to a moment. Others transcend it. The BOCA Heritage is built around a simple idea: good design should feel familiar without belonging to any particular era. Clean lines, balanced proportions, and thoughtful details give it a character that feels both nostalgic and distinctly contemporary. With its compact 35 mm stainless steel case , Heritage draws inspiration from the beautifully proportioned watches of the past. Its clean dial, applied indexes, date window, and polished details give the watch a distinctive vintage character while maintaining the simplicity that defines BOCA. Available in three distinctive dial colors — Ivory, Light Blue, and Sage — each version gives Heritage a different personality. From the warmth and understated elegance of Ivory to the fresh character of Light Blue and the subtle sophistication of Sage, the collection was designed to be effortlessly versatile. At its heart is the reliable Japanese Miyota 2115 quartz movement , chosen for its precision, durability, and dependability. Like every BOCA watch, Heritage is paired with one of our signature handcrafted leather straps, made in Mexico by our artisans . Each strap is carefully woven by hand using premium sheepskin leather, bringing texture, warmth, and the unmistakable character of something made by human hands. No two straps are exactly alike. The restrained proportions of the case and the texture of the handwoven leather create a natural balance between refinement and craftsmanship — between the precision of traditional watch design and the individuality of something made by hand. Designed in the spirit of BOCA's philosophy — Italian Design × Mexican Craft — Heritage is a reminder that true style doesn't need to follow time. It becomes part of it. Specifications Movement: Japanese Miyota 2115 Quartz Functions: Hours, Minutes, Seconds, Date Case Diameter: 35 mm / 1.38 in Case Thickness: 8 mm / 0.31 in Case: Stainless Steel Watch Face Colors: Sage Caseback: Screw-Type Stainless Steel Strap: Handmade in Mexico using premium sheepskin leather, 18/16 mm / 0.71/0.63 in * Leather Strap Care and Maintenance Water Resistance: 5 ATM / 50 meters Warranty: 2 Years HERITAGE. Made to outlast trends. *The color and texture of the leather used for our watch straps may vary slightly depending on the specific leather batch available at the time of production. Each strap is handmade, and natural variations are part of its unique character.

watches.name: Kiin Blue with Brown Wristband
watches.description: KIIN Time, Through a Different Lens In the ancient Mayan language, Kiin means Time . More than a watch, the BOCA Kiin is a tribute to one of humanity's oldest obsessions: measuring time while embracing the present moment. Inspired by vintage chronographs, the Kiin combines timeless design with modern reliability. Its rich matte blue dial evokes the lush landscapes of the Yucatán Peninsula and the deep connection the Mayan civilization maintained with nature. Silver indexes provide elegant contrast and exceptional legibility, while the vibrant red chronograph hand adds a bold touch of character and energy. At its heart beats the renowned TMI (Seiko Instruments) VK63 Mecha-Quartz Chronograph movement , a hybrid mechanism that combines the precision and reliability of quartz technology with the satisfying feel of a mechanical chronograph. The result is exceptional accuracy and a smooth, crisp chronograph action appreciated by watch enthusiasts around the world. Like every BOCA watch, the Kiin is paired with one of our signature handcrafted leather straps, made in Mexico by our artisans . Each strap is woven by hand using sixteen individual strands of premium sheepskin leather, a process that requires patience, skill, and attention to detail. No two straps are exactly alike. The watch also features a distinctive crown designed exclusively for this model and a unique caseback engraving depicting the Quetzal , one of the most sacred birds in Mesoamerican culture. Revered by the Maya as a symbol of freedom, beauty, prosperity, and the connection between earth and sky, the Quetzal was considered a divine creature whose brilliant feathers were more valuable than gold. More than a watch, the BOCA Kiin is a tribute to one of humanity's oldest obsessions: measuring time while embracing the present moment. Inspired by vintage chronographs, the Kiin combines timeless design with modern reliability. Its rich matte green dial evokes the lush landscapes of the Yucatán Peninsula and the deep connection the Mayan civilization maintained with nature. Silver indexes provide elegant contrast and exceptional legibility, while the vibrant red chronograph hand adds a bold touch of character and energy. At its heart beats the renowned TMI (Seiko Instruments) VK63 Mecha-Quartz Chronograph movement , a hybrid mechanism that combines the precision and reliability of quartz technology with the satisfying feel of a mechanical chronograph. The result is exceptional accuracy and a smooth, crisp chronograph action appreciated by watch enthusiasts around the world. Like every BOCA watch, the Kiin is paired with one of our signature handcrafted leather straps, made in Mexico by our artisans . Each strap is woven by hand using sixteen individual strands of premium sheepskin leather, a process that requires patience, skill, and attention to detail. No two straps are exactly alike. The watch also features a distinctive crown designed exclusively for this model and a unique caseback engraving depicting the white-tailed deer , one of the most revered animals in Mayan culture. A symbol of grace, abundance, harmony, and the deep relationship between humanity and nature, the deer embodies the spirit of the forests that sustained generations of Mayan communities. This engraving serves as a subtle reminder of the natural world and the traditions that inspired the creation of the Kiin. Designed in the spirit of BOCA's philosophy — Italian Design × Mexican Craft — the Kiin celebrates the beauty of time, tradition, and human hands. Specifications Movement: TMI (Seiko Instruments) VK63 Mecha-Quartz Chronograph Case Diameter: 39 mm / 1.53 in Case Thickness: 10 mm / 0.39 in Case: Stainless Steel Watch Face: Matte Green Dial Details: Silver Indexes, Red Chronograph Seconds Hand, Exclusive Crown Design Caseback: Engraved White-Tailed Deer Caseback Strap: Handmade in Mexico using premium sheepskin leather, 20/18 mm / 0.79/0.71 in *Leather Strap Care and Maintenance Water Resistance: 5 ATM / 50 meters Warranty: 2 Years KIIN. Time, honored. *The color and texture of the leather used for our watch straps may vary slightly depending on the specific leather batch available at the time of production. Each strap is handmade, and natural variations are part of its unique character.

Roman numerals, elegant hour markers, and vintage-inspired hands bring depth and personality to the dial, while the day and date complications add functionality without compromising its balanced design. Like every BOCA watch, the Imperiale is paired with one of our signature handcrafted leather straps, made in Mexico by our artisans .
